Гриндилка-фармилка. После 2–3 серий из 3 миссий (операций) против каждой из фракций ничего нового ты уже не увидишь. Ну, конечно, где-то будет новый биом, где-то один новый моб, где-то какое-то уникальное задание, но сильно погоды это не делает. И в итоге часов 5–7 на каждую из фракций — и ты уже, считай, про. Далее только фармить и гриндить разные валюты, чтобы сначала открывать новые базовые стратагемы, потом качать свой корабль, потом оружие, потом покупать и качать варбонды (местные боевые пропуски).

И хоть геймплей в игре очень даже приятный, ещё на 30-м часу для меня он превратился просто в рутину, которую немного разнообразят новые пушки, сеты и стратагемы, но всё ещё рутину, которая нужна для прокачки.

Но самое большое для меня разочарование — это кампании Helldivers 2. По рассказам, ты то штурмуешь планеты-заводы автоматонов, то штурмуешь миры-ульи жуков, то уже враги штурмуют Супер-Землю. И по этим же рассказам всё это сделано очень круто, эпично и так далее.

Но вот вышло обновление «Бездна Несвободы», в котором открылась Бездна, грозящая поглотить всю галактику. Глобальная угроза, всё очень плохо. И её просто, без каких-либо проблем, закрывают за одну кампанию. (¯▿¯)

Ну и как итог, для меня Helldivers 2 — безусловно уникальная, но на данный момент не такая легендарная игра, как многие говорят. Зайти раз в один-два месяца на несколько троек часов, поглотить немногочисленный новый контент, покачать новые пушки и поюзать новые стратагемы — пойдёт. И всё же, я считаю, что своих денег она не стоит, даже с учётом всей прошлой и будущей бесплатной поддержки. 

P.S. Ещё забыл упомянуть многочисленные баги и проблемы с оптимизацией.

[h1]TL;DR[/h1]
Helldivers 2 is a blast with friends, but the developer's track record (bugs, almost zero QA, poor communication, balance-by-Warbond) keeps it from being an easy recommendation. [b]Worth it on a good sale, not at full price.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]PROS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Absurdly fun with friends
[*] Randomized terrain every match keeps you thinking up new combat strategies, so no two drops feel the same
[*] Teamwork is the whole point: stick together or split up to get everything done before the clock runs out
[*] Different enemies need the right weapons, so choose your loadout wisely (or enjoy being the guy who brought a pea shooter to a Bile Titan fight)
[*] Hilarious lore, and the community is never short on memes
[*] Great performance (~100 FPS) with DLSS on Balanced at Ultrawide (3840x1440)
[*] 100% PvE, and may it stay that way, for the love of Managed Democracy
[*] Friendly fire forces you to actually play as a squad with real strategy: covering fire, flanking, setting traps, or splitting up to hit objectives
[*] Warbonds work like battle passes, but they never expire. You can buy them with Super Credits farmed in-game, or pay up if you'd rather spend money than time
[/list]

[h1]CONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Even though it's a PvE game, friendly fire is on 100% of the time. You [b]WILL[/b] get mad at random players, especially griefers
[*] Lots of bugs since launch: enemies clipping through walls, terminals that don't work, map resources you can't collect, and dead creatures whose bodies vanish but whose collision stays behind, so you get stuck on a corpse that technically doesn't exist
[*] Almost zero QA on new patches. Arrowhead (AH) is backed by Sony's PlayStation, so the money is there, but they either don't know how (or don't want) to properly invest in the live-service game they've been desperately hoping would succeed for years
[*] AH is terrible at clearly communicating patch changes. Weapon and stratagem nerfs land with no announcement at all, and the community has to discover them the hard way
[*] Quality-of-life updates are nearly nonexistent. The Stratagem beacon bouncing on the ground is what annoys me the most, and despite thousands of complaints, it's still there
[*] EAC anti-cheat implementation: performance loss, random crashes (including the game crashing on launch), and broken QoL mods, with no known permanent fix. Reddit solutions may or may not work, so pray to the RNG gods
[*] AH can't seem to balance anything: they force changes through nerfs and then "fix" them by releasing a new Warbond. Create the problem, sell the solution 🤡
[*] No region-based matchmaking, so it's harder to find teammates who speak your native language (if it isn't English). English is almost mandatory to coordinate, and players using dubbed audio and a localized interface struggle to align strategy with the team, which pushes them toward Discord servers to find squads. The language isn't a problem for me (the ping, on the other hand...)
[*] The Super Citizen (Deluxe) Edition is pretty underwhelming. $20 extra for so little in return. You're better off saving the money, or buying 2,000 Super Credits in-game and unlocking 2 decent Warbonds instead
[/list]

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]
Helldivers 2 is a blast with friends, but the issues with the developer give the impression that they either don't care about the community and its feedback, or they have serious internal management problems running a live-service game. Community Discord servers (including regional ones) make it easy to find people to play with.

A "Recommended, with reservations" button would be more honest. That said: [b]I only recommend buying it on a good sale.[/b]

Me alisté el 20 de julio de 2024. Tras 659 horas en el frente combatiendo a bichos y chatarras, todo cambió en febrero de 2026.
Vi las luces azules en la frontera. Sé perfectamente lo que vi: los Iluminados. Poco después, antes del 20 de marzo de 2026, mi señal de radio se apagó y desaparecí en combate.
Me abdujeron y me destrozaron la mente con intrusiones psíquicas que aún hoy me cuesta asimilar. Al regresar a territorio controlado en julio de 2026, la policía militar ya me esperaba.
Fui arrestado de inmediato por deserción agravada.
Al tribunal le dio igual que me hubieran capturado; para ellos simplemente me había tomado unas vacaciones no autorizadas. Para evitar el fusilamiento, me metieron a la fuerza en un Centro de Reeducación de la Supertierra.
Fueron meses durísimos de aislamiento y terapia de choque para obligarme a aceptar la versión oficial: que los Iluminados no existen y que todo fue una psicosis. 
Me dejaron jodido y paranoico, pero listo para servir. He vuelto al servicio activo este pasado julio de 2026. El Vacío ya ha desaparecido del mapa galáctico y nos han mandado directos al frente Termínido a purgar a los supuestos disidentes tras el desastre del Termicida TCS+. 
Ahora mismo disparo a todo lo que se mueve. No sé si son traidores o proyecciones de mi cabeza, pero aprieto el gatillo porque es lo único que me mantiene cuerdo. 

Evaluación de combate:
Jugabilidad: 10/10 (El armamento contundente ayuda a ahogar el trauma).
Atmósfera: 10/10 (La opresión de la Supertierra y la tensión de la guerra te calan hasta los huesos).
Sanidad Militar: 10/10 (Te recomponen a base de golpes para que sigas sirviendo como carne de cañón).
Ya cumplí mi condena y firmé los papeles de lealtad, pero sé que me vigilan. Si flaqueo, me envían de vuelta a la trena. Las luces azules siguen parpadeando en la oscuridad de mi monitor.

映画スターシップトゥルーパーズのアホなノリと
ゲーム地球防衛軍をくっつけたようなゲーム
大量の虫やロボ、宇宙人に銃を乱射したり、爆散したいなら
オススメの一本

キャラの強化要素はなく
持ち込む兵器と防具でビルドを構成して戦う
他のメンバーのビルド見て、考えるのも面白い

マルチは部屋制で、ほぼ途中参加形式になるが
未だに人は多く、入る部屋に困ることは無い
というのも未だにアップデートで兵器追加や敵追加
マップの追加なども行っている
１，２ヶ月に１つは何かしらの追加がある

スーパークレジットというゲーム内通過で
ウォーボンドというテーマ兵器詰め合わせを購入して
兵器などを開放していく形なのだが
スーパークレジットはゲーム内入手とリアルマネー入手の２通りがある
全てリアルマネーで購入しようと思うと数万円かかるが
一応半日ぐらい稼ぎをすると１０００ぐらいは稼げるので
稼ぎ作業が苦でなければいくらでも稼げる
普通にプレイしていても、マップの？マークポイントをちゃんと回っていれば
それなりに貯まっていくので、課金圧は感じない

ウォーボンドの種類が多く最初はどれをとるか迷うが
個人的なオススメは
・民主主義大爆発（爆発系兵器が全部強い）
・ダストデビル（コヨーテがどこでも使えるぐらい強い）
ぐらいで後はお好み

スーパークレジット稼ぎが苦でなければ
・コントロールグループ（ワープパックでロックされている倉庫に入れる）
・エクソエキスパート（移動速度が上がるアーマーが快適）
をとって効率化を図るのも有り


最初のうちはビルドの幅も狭く
強い構成を使いがちで、すぐ飽きてくるが
開放ウォーボンドが増え、使える兵器が増えてくると
ビルド構成幅が広がり楽しさが増してくる

慣れてきて１人で？ポイント巡回したり
敵の群れの処理や、大型の処理がスムーズになってくると
更に楽しさは増す


このゲームの悪いところとして
フレンドリーファイア要素があり、これが結構頻繁に起こる
これがないとゲームが大味になりすぎるとは思うものの
不快に感じる点も多々ある、というか不快要素の殆どが
フレンドリーファイア関連のトラブルなので、なんともしがたいポイントではある

Been playing since the game came out on PS5, had to move over to PC. The lack of cross-progression is incredibly disappointing. Not only that, but hearing that PC users had issues with this game in the past made me nervous to try it out on Steam. Lo and behold, the game took me like 2 days of looking up YT video guides and tech support advice to get the game working, asking people on official discord how to fix the most mundane things... this shouldn't be this hard to set up, or alternatively, this game should not be so terribly optimized.

Furthermore, after playing this game for a while the apparent lack of QoL updates and much-requested features has left me stumped as a longtime fan. In addition, the last few updates have felt antagonistic towards the playerbase. I used to enjoy the many events, warbond quality and sense of community, but now it seems that all of these things have fizzled out for the most part, with the quality of the game massively decreasing to a bug-ridden shadow of its former self.

3.5/10

Maybe wait until the sequel...

I really want to like this game but I really don't like super credits. I find the whole concept of paid gameplay content in a already paid game kinda horrible honestly. I hate this has become normal. My biggest issue isn't the dev's monetizing their game it's the fact the monetized content is gameplay features such as guns, armor, and stratagems. The time I had with this game was fun and unique but I just don't feel like spending $150 to $200 to just unlock them not even get them. I know you can farm super credits but I've tried and honestly it isn't fun or worth while. I rather play the video game. Of course I wouldn't criticize so heavily unless I had some kind of suggestion. A game such as Deep Rock Galactic which has paid content. However it's entirely cosmetic content and all gameplay content is completely free every season such as guns. So perhaps focus on cosmetics and make armor entirely visual instead of having a set bonus for specific armors. Another suggestion is making warbonds purchasable with medal and then keep super credit to purchase warbonds but it unlocks the whole thing rather then grinding medal. I would personally wouldn't mind removing farming super credits if it was this way if it isn't super grindy with the amount of medal that is needed to complete a warbond. I don't typically leave reviews but I find this game fun and unique. I did enjoy this game and will probably give it another chance one day however at the moment I'm displeased with the super credit system.
